import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    q = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    operations = [sys.stdin.readline().strip() for _ in range(q)]
    history = []
    current = defaultdict(int)
    current_priorities = []
    current_assignments = []

    for day in range(q):
        op = operations[day].split()
        if op[0] == 'set':
            ai, xi = op[1], int(op[2])

                current_priorities.remove(old_priority)
            current[ai] = xi
            current_assignments.append(ai)
            current_priorities.append(xi)
            history.append((current.copy(), current_assignments.copy(), current_priorities.copy()))

            ai = op[1]
            if ai in current:
                old_priority = current[ai]
                current_assignments.remove(ai)
                current_priorities.remove(old_priority)
                del current[ai]
            history.append((current.copy(), current_assignments.copy(), current_priorities.copy()))
        elif op[0] == 'query':
            ai = op[1]
            if ai not in current:
                print(-1)
                sys.stdout.flush()
            else:
                count = 0
                for p in current_priorities:
                    if p < current[ai]:
                        count += 1
                print(count)
                sys.stdout.flush()
